programme.sub-title: Tall Buildings, Fast Animals and Expensive Cities

programme.sub-title: Long Lives, Destructive Weather and Speed Records
programme.desc: In this episode of Extremes, you will learn about extreme close-up photography, long lives, destructive weather and speed records.

programme.title: Health Explored S1 - "Human Performance"
programme.desc: How is it that some people have been able to reach the pinnacle of our human performance? Guided by Dr. David Behm, an expert in sports physiology, we uncover the fascinating intersection of science and athletic performance.

programme.title: Health Explored S1 - "The Blue Mind Part 1"
programme.desc: Why are we drawn to water? Is it just a nice view or is there more under the surface. We ask the question – does being close to or in water actually improve our health?

programme.title: Health Explored S1 - "The Blue Mind Part 2"
programme.desc: Travel to Taranaki to learn about the innovative surf therapy program, Taupo to learn about the Maori connection with water and other fascinating take homes about our mental health.

programme.title: Health Explored S1 - "The Search for Mindfulness Part 1"
programme.desc: India’s ancient traditions have fostered a culture of spirituality which resonates through everything. We explore how India is able to find order in a fast paced world.

programme.title: Health Explored S1 - "The Search for Mindfulness Part 2"
programme.desc: Journey to the school of Happiness and learn about Karma in this second part of our India adventure. We travel from the Himalayas back to central Delhi with a new perspective on what mindfulness really means.

programme.title: Health Explored S1 - "The Pursuit of Happiness Part 1"
programme.desc: Bhutan embraces happiness above all else for its citizens. This approach has made Bhutan a model for health around the world. Is happiness the key to better health?

programme.title: Health Explored S1 - "The Pursuit of Happiness Part 2"
programme.desc: Mike learns what happiness means to the people of Bhutan. He visits a school and a rural farm and learns how happiness is integrated into day-to-day life and leaves a note for his father at the famous Tigers Nest temple.

programme.title: Health Explored S1 - "Forest Bathing"
programme.desc: Learn how this deeply rooted Japanese tradition of forest bathing offers both physical and psychological benefits, opening your mind and tuning your senses to the therapeutic powers of nature.

programme.title: Health Explored S1 - "The Purpose of Life Part 1"
programme.desc: We learn about Ikigai and the reason for being that is so fundamental for life in Okinawa. We visit gardeners, play gate ball and meet an elder who is heralded for her wellness in the famous Miss Kitanakagusku contest.

programme.title: Health Explored S1 - "The Purpose of Life Part 2"
programme.desc: Have you ever hiked using your ears, nose and tongue? We learn about the ancient practice of Shin Rin Yoku or Forest Bathing on the outskirts of the worlds largest city.

programme.title: Health Explored S1 - "Planting a Seed"
programme.desc: With the guidance of a local soil scientist, follow Mike's hands-on journey into the art and science of farming sustainably.

programme.title: Health Explored S1 - "Pushing our Limits"
programme.desc: Uncover the multifaceted impact of stress on our well-being, and gain fascinating insights into how various stressors impact our physiological responses.

programme.title: Health Explored S2 - "Open Air Life Part 1"
programme.desc: Travel to Tromso to learn about the concept of "Open Air Life" from the inhabitants of this arctic region.

programme.title: Health Explored S2 - "Open Air Life Part 2"
programme.desc: Go sea to summit with a skiing experience, as we trek to an unskiied peak, then go diving in the frozen ocean.

programme.title: Health Explored S2 - "Sands of Time Part 1"
programme.desc: From environmental health to physical health, discover what coastal life is like in Morocco before heading inland to the desert.

programme.title: Health Explored S2 - "Sands of Time Part 2"
programme.desc: Trek into the Sahara to camp and visit the nomads, to learn how climate change is impacting life in the desert and why time should be valued.

programme.title: Health Explored S2 - "Pura Vida Part 1"
programme.desc: "Pura Vida" is a popular saying in Costa Rica, often translated as "pure life" or "simple life." We learn from centenarians from the Blue Zone why we should live a pure life.

programme.title: Health Explored S2 - "Pura Vida Part 2"
programme.desc: We learn about conservation in Costa Rica from reforestation projects, to sustainable fishing and endangered turtle rescue.

programme.title: Health Explored S2 - "A Taste of Life Part 1"
programme.desc: Why does Sardinia stand alone as Europe's Healthiest Community? Is it the coast, the pastures or the mountains that grant its residences with longevity?

programme.title: Health Explored S2 - "A Taste of Life Part 2"
programme.desc: Learn about the foods and the culture that makes Sardinia so special. From fishing with their hands, to traditional foods... it's a culinary exploration in good health.

programme.title: Health Explored S2 - "Adaptation"
programme.desc: Travel to La Paz, Bolivia, to see how high altitude impacts the body. From science to tradition, visit the witches market and learn about an ancient Inca medicine for altitude sickness

programme.title: Health Explored S2 - "Superfoods"
programme.desc: The high altitude environment makes foods that are considered "super". From quinoa, to special beans and salt - We travel from the Uyuni Salt flats back to La Paz to work with a Master Chef.

programme.title: Health Explored S2 - "Mother Earth"
programme.desc: Travel to the world's highest lake to see what is happening in this fragile ecosystem. We finish our Bolivian adventure with a ceremony honouring our planet.

programme.title: Health Explored S2 - "What We Learned"
programme.desc: The small team share their most impactful moments, stories, places and people, and how they changed their lives and health.

programme.title: Ancient Engineering S1 - "The Great Wall of China"

programme.title: Ancient Engineering S1 - "Secrets Of The Pyramids"

programme.title: Ancient Engineering S1 - "Rise Of The Super-Castle"

programme.title: Ancient Engineering S1 - "Secrets Of Notre Dame"

programme.title: War Machines S1 - "Mastering Arms"

programme.title: War Machines S1 - "Advancing Destruction"

programme.title: War Machines S1 - "Triumphant On Land"
programme.desc: Highlighting some of the most influential movers ever to take to the battlefield including some of the most infamous tanks.
